planItem: 77.44.7.A — Legacy media Inspector warning and field lifecycle
finding: Malformed legacy media fields and unsafe source/poster URLs displayed role=status warnings without programmatically associating those messages with the field or media-library control that repairs them.
change: Each status warning has a stable unique id and is appended to aria-describedby on its affected text input and media-library open control. Existing description tokens are preserved, and resolved warning IDs are removed from the fields. Stable message IDs avoid replacing unchanged live regions on every edit.
openSourceReview: Reused project-owned native aria-describedby and status patterns from composition-inputs.js, authored-content controls, and the Inspector. No third-party code or dependency was needed.

assertions: corrupt image source, alt and library asset feedback targets resolve exactly once
corrupt video source, poster and library controls resolve to status
corrupt audio source and library controls resolve to status
unsafe image URL warning resolves and is removed from aria-describedby after repair
unsafe video poster URL warning resolves to the poster field and picker, then clears on repair
draft Save leaves public output unchanged
separate Publish updates public legacy media and the repaired poster
tests.initialAttempt: The first browser attempt exposed a stale test locator querying the Inspector tab as a button; updated it to the current role=tab contract and reran the full test successfully.

assertionsAdded: unsafe javascript poster URL accessibility association
stale warning relationship cleanup after repair
Save/Publish poster isolation and public output

followUpUnsafeUrlEntry.finding: An unsafe legacy media URL could be entered into an otherwise valid Inspector field and accepted by element.update. The renderers filtered it at output time, but the editor gave no field error and retained the unsafe draft value.
followUpUnsafeUrlEntry.regressionBeforeFix: The new real-Chromium assertion failed: aria-invalid was null after entering javascript:alert(1) into a valid legacy video poster field.
followUpUnsafeUrlEntry.fix: Legacy media source and video poster edits now trim and validate non-empty values with the existing safeMediaUrl contract before invoking element.update. The existing composition input control exposes rejection inline, keeps the prior Page Model value, and allows safe repair. Persisted malformed legacy values still load unchanged so authors can repair them.
additionalAssertions: new unsafe video poster and audio source URLs are marked invalid and do not reach Canvas or the Editor Save API
safe repair clears invalid state and updates Canvas
existing malformed legacy URL warning, media picker association, no external request, Save/Publish separation, and public renderer checks remain covered
followUpUnsafeUrlEntry.openSourceReview: Reused the existing project-owned safeMediaUrl validator and composition-inputs inline validation; no external code or dependency was needed.

acceptanceBoundary: This verifies the listed legacy media warning associations and browser lifecycle only. Full 77.44.7.A and 79 element × 68 property acceptance remain OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED; manual/physical acceptance remains deferred until the complete Visual Editor is implemented.
